entry.title: Serverless routing made sticky
entry.summary: Voice agents, multiplayer games, and other workloads can now build on Sticky Sessions. Achieve strong affinity without losing autoscaling. Here’s how we built this on Modal Servers.

entry.title: NVIDIA Vera CPUs double throughput for Modal Sandboxes
entry.summary: We benchmarked NVIDIA's new Arm-based Vera CPU on agentic Sandbox workloads. Under heavy load, it completes far more tasks than the x86 and Graviton alternatives, without sacrificing latency.

entry.title: Modal crosses $1B in Annualized Run Rate and raises $750M Series D
entry.summary:
Modal has crossed $1B in annualized run rate and raised a $750M Series D led by Accel to build new infrastructure for AI applications.
We can't think of a better time to be building software.

entry.title: Toward RL on mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers
entry.summary: We trained a model on agentic coding tasks using fully asynchronous RL and mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers. With off-policy correction, training stayed stable through convergence, on par with homogeneous samplers, at a lower cost.
